comments.message:
FOUR! Romario Shepherd to Sanju Samson. Reverse Swing-In half volley, off stump on the front foot driving, well timed in the air under control past long on for 4 runs. Sanju Samson seals it in style with a boundary, and India storm into the semi-finals! What a magnificent innings from Samson - an extraordinary, unbeaten 97 that guided India calmly across the finish line. He anchored the chase with composure and class, timing his acceleration to perfection.
Tilak Varma played a crucial supporting role, contributing a valuable knock that kept the momentum steady during the middle overs. The West Indies bowlers struggled to contain the flow of runs, and some sloppy fielding further hurt their chances. Despite the defeat, it has been a commendable tournament for the West Indies, with several positives to take forward. Sanju Samson is deservedly named the Player of the Match for his match-winning masterclass.
